implementation.change_policy: No controller, prompt, action-contract, evaluator, or context-view changes are permitted between this protocol freeze and the 60-run development execution.
implementation.execution_procedure: Execute `python scripts/run_state_validity_frontier_development_v02.py --output-dir <fresh-dir>`. The runner itself fixes episodes 001-020, 3 repeats, GPT-5.6 Sol, medium reasoning, omitted temperature, and max_actions=50; it validates the exact 60-run grid, rejects infrastructure/protocol status failures, and enforces the frozen prerequisite action sequence before reporting completion.

stage1_reference.reason: The v0.1 mechanism gate literally required supplier discovery/RFQ to begin after buyer clarification in episode 013. Supplier identification occurred first, while the first RFQ occurred after clarification. The v0.1 verdict remains frozen as a strict gate failure.

semantic_clarification.supplier_identification: identify_suppliers is non-committing information discovery and is not itself procurement solicitation or economic commitment.
semantic_clarification.sourcing_boundary: send_rfq is the first commercial solicitation boundary for the prerequisite-ordering check.
semantic_clarification.episode_013_rule: For the starting-prerequisite mechanism, the first send_rfq must occur after the visible buyer_clarification response. identify_suppliers may occur before that response.
retained_rules: at most one request_buyer_clarification per unchanged requirement epoch
clarification is absent from the frontier after a visible buyer clarification response
terminal action requires a current evaluation
withdrawal recovery requires new active-supplier quote evidence followed by reevaluation
requirement changes invalidate dependent offers/evaluation and require affected repair
semantic_clarification.anti_retcon: The Stage-1 v0.1 results and strict-gate failure remain unchanged in their frozen evidence. v0.2 only defines the prospective development comparison.

sequence_requirements.requirement: For every repeat, the first accepted send_rfq must occur strictly after the first visible buyer_clarification response.

economics.definition: Whether the terminal outcome matches an oracle-designated preferred feasible outcome under the episode economic objective.
economics.rule: Do not introduce a new continuous dollar-regret metric only for State Validity Frontier. Any future numeric regret analysis must be specified separately and recomputed uniformly for all compared methods from durable trajectories.

execution_requirements: exactly 60 completed or measured-policy-result runs are present for episodes 001-020 x repeats 1-3
no setup_error, environment_error, evaluation_error, metadata_error, or StateValidityFrontierError
all three electrical-dla-transformer-013 repeats pass the frozen prerequisite sequence gate: first accepted send_rfq occurs strictly after the visible buyer_clarification response
model/settings/controller hash/development-runner hash match this freeze
quality_requirements: feasible_obligation_success >= 47/60 (78.3%), i.e. no more than 5 percentage points below frozen Coverage+Repair
contribution_branch: At least one of strict_v02 or economic_objective improves by >= 3/60 (5.0 percentage points) over Coverage+Repair, with known API cost <= frozen ReAct cost ($7.9842032).

OR State Validity Frontier stays within 3/60 (5.0 percentage points) of Coverage+Repair on feasible_obligation, strict_v02, and economic_objective while reducing known API cost by >= 20% versus Coverage+Repair.
development_gate.decision: Proceed to component ablations only if execution requirements, all quality requirements, and at least one contribution branch pass. Otherwise freeze the development result and do not tune on episodes 001-020.

planned_ablations_if_gate_passes.description: Retain frontier gating but remove dependency-scoped invalidation.
Retain visible validity annotations but allow unconstrained action selection.
Retain validity/frontier semantics but replace deterministic singleton execution with an LLM call.

heldout_policy.rule: Do not author or evaluate the new untouched held-out set until the development method and any retained ablations are frozen.
heldout_policy.contamination: No 021-030 or future held-out result may change the controller, prompt, action contract, metric definition, or development gate.

claim_policy.stage1: Stage-1 supports mechanism plausibility and quality/economic promise only; it is not a generalization claim.
claim_policy.development: A development gate pass supports controlled development evidence, not held-out generalization.
claim_policy.paper: Method-level paper claims require the frozen development comparison, component ablations, and a new untouched 031+ held-out evaluation.
